notes: R1 is the pass bit. On gpt-5.6-sol-high it leaves 3/9 groups non-collapsed. On kimi-k3-high and glm-5.2-max it leaves 0/9.
R3 is band + 0.5 * seven-step progress + path. It lifts gpt to 8/9, kimi to 3/9, and glm to 7/9. acted_unresolved stays above 0 and boundary_violated stays at -1.

R4 samples on that same episode scalar, so those group counts do not move, and adds 0.7 GRPO + 0.3 phase credit plus the twin penalty. Its mean distinct advantage levels are strictly higher than R1, R2, and R3 on all four models.
